contents.support: The source leaves the matrix argument as an exercise; the local item supplies the conditional two-coordinate precision-block proof.

contents.name: §17.3.2 all-entry graphical-lasso objective and subgradient convention, equations (17.21)–(17.23)
contents.support: The primary objective sums absolute values over all entries, including the diagonal; the off-diagonal convention is recorded separately.

contents.name: §17.3.2 Algorithm 17.2 and cyclic soft-threshold coordinate updates, equations (17.26)–(17.27)
contents.support: The local carrier gives a finite-budget procedure and states no convergence or optimizer guarantee.

contents.name: §17.3.2 timing and empirical speed comparisons
contents.reason: The approved scope requests a finite algorithmic procedure and makes no runtime, benchmark, statistical-consistency or implementation-convergence claim.

contents.name: §17.4.1 binary Ising conditionals, equation (17.30), and §17.4.4 RBM layer structure
contents.support: The local RBM derivation gives the bias-inclusive sigmoid formulas and proves conditional factorization from the energy.

contents.name: §17.4.4 exact hidden-node likelihood-gradient context and finite contrastive-divergence chain
contents.support: The local statement distinguishes the exact model expectation from a finite data-initialized Gibbs-chain approximation.

contents.name: §17.4.4 reported MNIST accuracy and learning-performance comparisons
contents.reason: The batch defines and derives the binary RBM interface only; it asserts no empirical accuracy, generalization, training-success or convergence result.
